pNone_chapter_1: In a dimly lit apartment on Harrison Road, Byomkesh Bakshi and Ajit Bandyopadhyay sit across from each other at a low wooden table, focused on a game of chess. Byomkesh, lean and sharp-eyed in his white dhoti-kurta, leans forward to move a pawn while Ajit watches with a concentrated expression. A heavy ceiling fan rotates slowly above them, casting rhythmic shadows across the room’s high ceilings and shuttered windows. The atmosphere is thick with the golden, hazy light of a sweltering Calcutta afternoon, with a thin trail of smoke rising from a cigarette resting in an ashtray.
